description: Ganoderma / BSR risk classification dataset manifest

sources.name: Gotani Ganoderma Dataset
sources.notes: May include hyperspectral or small-sample data; verify RGB availability

label_notes: v1 conservative labels. Without expert or lab confirmation, all risk labels are 'suspected', never 'confirmed'. Future expansion may add: suspected_early, moderate, severe, dead_or_collapsed.

split_strategy.constraint: Images from the same tree or plantation block must stay in the same split
split_strategy.notes: Ganoderma data is often small-sample; consider stratified sampling to preserve class balance

notes: raw layer accepts any format including CSV, JSON, COCO, or custom
importers normalize to classification directory structure
Ganoderma risk is NEVER confirmed without expert evidence
